about.title: About Splatoon 3 AI Coach
about.p1: This website is a personal project that I develop and maintain on my own.
about.p2: I’m a big Splatoon fan myself, and I’ve been playing since the original Splatoon. Splatoon 3 in particular has really hooked me—I can’t think of many other games I’ve enjoyed this much. And honestly, building this AI coach has become just as much fun for me as playing the game itself.
about.p3: As a player, I’ve made it to S+, but my highest X Power is only around 1700, so I still have plenty of room to improve. I’m hoping that building and using this AI coach will help me become a better player, too. And if people who use it come away thinking, “That helped me improve,” or even just, “That was useful,” I’ll be very happy.
about.p4: One of the most important principles behind this app is to start with what can actually be observed.
about.p5: The goal is to detect information from the match footage as accurately as possible and record it as evidence without adding assumptions or interpretations. From that evidence, the app builds a picture of what was happening during the match and uses those situations as the basis for practical coaching advice. Finally, AI is used to turn that advice into language that is clear, useful, and easy for a player to put into practice.
about.p6: In other words, the idea isn’t simply to “show a match to an AI and have it come up with some advice.” The goal is to first establish what actually happened, then build the coaching on evidence. That’s one of the core ideas behind how I’m building this app.
about.source_before: The source code is public on
about.source_after: , so if you’re interested, feel free to check it out.
about.p7: I’d also love to hear your feedback, impressions, or ideas for features you’d like to see. Feel free to send them through the contact form. I hope this tool can help you improve, even if just a little. Have a great battle!
